description: Immutable Graham Number selection with an optional book-value override.

as_of.description: Run the analysis as of this date (the end of that day, UTC) or this moment, which needs a timezone offset; leave empty for the latest data.
as_of.title: As Of

bvps_override.description: Book value per share to use instead of the reported figure; leave empty to use it.
bvps_override.title: Bvps Override

eps_override.description: Earnings per share to use instead of the reported figure; leave empty to use it.
eps_override.title: Eps Override

quote_override.description: Share price to use instead of the current quote; leave empty to use the quote.
quote_override.title: Quote Override

use_cache.description: Whether the analysis may read and write the local cache of fetched data.
use_cache.title: Use Cache

title: GrahamNumberSelection
